turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm diving into motor control today. SimpleFOC uses classes such as BLDCMotor, BLDCDriver3PWM, and Encoder for implementation. It's surprisingly modular.
That modularity is definitely a strength of the library. It makes swapping components pretty straightforward.
Yeah, exactly. I also spent the morning fixing a leaky faucet in the kitchen. Not fun.
Plumbing issues are always a hassle. Did you manage to get it fixed?
Eventually. Just needed to replace the washer. Anyway, back to code.
Good to hear it's sorted. Are you working on a specific motor setup?
Just testing with a small drone motor for now. The weather outside is terrible, so I'm staying in.
Sounds like a good day for coding. Stay dry!
Lloyd, I was reading about entropy today. I learned that Information is calculated using the formula Bits = -log₂(p), where p is the probability of an event.
That's the classic Shannon formula. It’s fundamental to understanding data compression and communication.
Right. It’s interesting how low probability events carry more 'information'. I also finally got my new monitor stand delivered.
Nice upgrade! Is the assembly going smoothly?
Mostly. One screw was stripped, but I found a replacement. The weather is finally clearing up too.
Glad the weather is cooperating. Enjoy the new setup.
Will do. I might try calculating the entropy of some random text samples later.
That sounds like a fun experiment. Let me know if you need help with the math.
